evidence: The molybdenum and selenide precursors used were Mo(CO)6 (Strem) and (Me3Si)2Se (reproduced from the pioneering work by Ritala and co-workers) heated up to 55 and 50 °C, respectively. High purity nitrogen (99.9999%) was the carrier and purging gas at a flow rate of 500 standard cubic centimeters minute (sccm).
